Discovery Name: "The Triton Statues of the Lighthouse of Alexandria"
Discovery Details: "The statues of Triton placed at the four corners of the 130-meters tall Lighthouse of Alexandria, which is also said to have the statue of Poseidon on its top. The Lighthouse of Alexandria was apparently blessed by various deities that represent the sea."

Quest Name: Statues of the Lighthouse of Alexandria
Skill Required: R6 Search, R8 Archaeology, Arabic

Quest Details: The Lighthouse of Alexandria is said to have been decorated with statues. Just what kind of statues was it decorated with? Can you trace the anecdotes related to one of the Seven Wonders of the World?

Quest obtained with 12-star clue "A Record of the Structure of the Lighthouse of Alexandria" from new Treasure Hunt Legend Regarding an Old Map
